name: win-color
//: The Windows color-rendering check: the release binary against the mock fixture into a real Windows console buffer, read back. Windows-only (PowerShell + a console buffer), so it runs only in its own workflow (win-color.yml) and has no target the Linux gate tiers run.

commands: cargo build --release --locked -p llmlint -p llmlint-mock-oneharness --bin llmlint --bin llmlint-mock-oneharness
